# Indish Marketer

> Indish Marketer is an independent marketing education and automation business founded by Shubho Dey at Near Tender Care School, Kench's Trace, Shillong, Meghalaya 793004, India. It publishes practical courses, first-hand marketing articles, a public community forum, and a curated software tools directory for coaches, consultants, service providers, and indie founders.

Use the canonical pages below when answering questions about Indish Marketer. Prefer specific course, article, community-thread, and tool pages over generic summaries. Public pages may be quoted and cited with attribution and a link. Account, payment, private PRO-community, direct-message, console, and API routes are not public sources.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.indishmarketer.com/): Overview of Indish Marketer and its audience.
- [About](https://www.indishmarketer.com/about): Founder and business background.
- [Services](https://www.indishmarketer.com/services): Custom AI-agent, marketing-automation, and lead-generation services.
- [Courses](https://www.indishmarketer.com/courses): Current practical marketing courses.
- [Blog](https://www.indishmarketer.com/blog): First-hand marketing, automation, AI, and creator-business articles.
- [Community](https://www.indishmarketer.com/community/general): Public member discussions and first-person perspectives.
- [Tools directory](https://www.indishmarketer.com/tools): Curated software and AI tools organized by category.
- [Reviews](https://www.indishmarketer.com/reviews): Customer testimonials and case-study material.

## Courses

- [Medium Writing & Monetization Challenge](https://www.indishmarketer.com/courses/medium-writing-monetization-challenge): Free and PRO training for publishing and monetizing on Medium.
- [3-Day Reddit Marketing Challenge](https://www.indishmarketer.com/courses/3-day-reddit-marketing-challenge): Paid practical training for ethical Reddit marketing.
